scope: All interventions require an otherwise-approved genuine price-drop add and nextDepth >= selected depth. Timer-only adds remain unchanged, including after a rebound releases the drop condition. No persistent veto, sizing, exit, short or live changes.

rules.drop_sell_either: Veto taker15m <=0.85 OR taker1h <=0.9; both windows must be known
rules.drop_confirm_both: Require taker15m >=1.2 AND taker1h >=1.0; no price-return condition
rules.drop_sr_sell15: Only within 0.3% below known resistance, veto taker15m <=0.85
rules.drop_sr_confirm: Only within 0.3% below known resistance, require taker15m >=1.2 AND taker1h >=1.0 AND ret15m >0

coverage: Required pulse must meet prior-study sample/freshness tests. Unknown required data leaves the experimental overlay inactive and is counted. Pulse cannot validate pre-HL history. Explicit receipt times respected; historical missing receipt modeled at window-end plus one minute. This is not certified live-arrival parity or a production missing-data choice.
diagnostics: Record first veto per episode/depth and the first subsequent allowed decision at that same episode/depth, including genuine-drop versus timer release and whether an actual next-open fill followed. A change of depth/episode is not a confirmation release. Deduplicated traces are not independent veto minutes or all repeat interventions.
qualification: Unchanged prior-study profit/defensive screens and minimum20 vetoed episodes in EACH HL TP model. All four baseline digests must match. Report near misses and opportunity costs; no post-result threshold changes. No live deployment; any advancement needs fresh forward evidence. Historical windows overlap and have already been mined.
